verses.text: All the congregation of the people of Israel moved on from the wilderness of Sin by stages, according to the commandment of the Lord, and camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.

They set out from Elim, and all the congregation of the people of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had departed from the land of Egypt.
And they set out from the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
And they set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

meaning_block.raw_text: A location first mentioned at Exo.16.1;
only referred to as Sin<H5512B> (סִין). § Sin = "thorn" or "clay" the tract of wilderness between Elim and Sinai
